title: DIO time verifier accepts sealed evidence from a different receiving LinkLayer
description: Correctness self-review of the sealed AuthenticatedDio integration: DioTimeVerifier is constructed with one exact receiving LinkLayer, but verify() currently checks only AuthenticatedDio.clock_domain_identity. Two LinkLayer instances intentionally sharing one MonotonicClock therefore share that token, so an AuthenticatedDio issued by link B can be passed to the verifier bound to link A. This bypasses the owning-link trust binding even though both DIO objects are individually authentic. Bind AuthenticatedDio to an opaque issuing/receiving LinkLayer identity and require exact identity in DioTimeVerifier before issuing TimeSample.
acceptance_criteria: AuthenticatedDio and LinkLayer expose an opaque instance-owned receiving-link identity compared only with 'is'; DioTimeVerifier rejects an AuthenticatedDio issued by another LinkLayer even when both share the same MonotonicClock and peer key; same-link sealed fan-out remains accepted; focused unit/vector tests, Ruff, strict mypy, and three independent rereviews pass.
